## Learning Objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Work with array data types and operations
- Handle JSON data extraction and manipulation
- Process nested and hierarchical data structures
- Perform advanced string operations on complex data

Real-world data often contains complex structures like arrays and JSON. This chapter
demonstrates how to work with these complex data types using Ibis.
